subject: Could not log into Shiny host -- Error occurred during transmission

messages.author: 4302125818ae30f5
messages.subject: Could not log into Shiny host -- Error occurred during transmission
parts:
Hey Guys,

I have been trying but I could not log into my Shiny host at:http://glimmer.rstudio.com:8787/

it showed "Error occurred during transmission".

Also when I tried to open my Shiny App, it showed "Fatal error: cannot mkdir R_TempDir"

Does anyone have similar problem?

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Could not log into Shiny host -- Error occurred during transmission
parts:
Hi - the partition containing the temp directory filled up, which caused the problems. Things should be working now.

-Winston

Lee
